subject: medicine
title: Syphilis and sexually transmitted infections: chancre to gummata

steps.tx: Take a history of a painless genital sore that healed over weeks, since a chancre marks primary syphilis. Ask about a non itchy rash over palms and soles with flu like illness, moist cauliflower warts, and purulent discharge with burning urination. Painful soft ulcers with a groin swelling suggest chancroid instead. Record partner numbers, condom use, and rectal or throat exposure, and screen every pregnancy because stillbirth and **congenital syphilis** threaten the baby. Note assault sensitively with **forensic care** in mind.
steps.say: Begin with any painless genital sore that healed over weeks, because a chancre is the mark of primary syphilis. Enquire about a non itchy rash on palms and soles that appears with flu like illness. Moist warts and burning discharge are also common, while painful soft ulcers suggest chancroid instead. Partner numbers with condom use are recorded, and rectal and throat exposure are asked about in every case. Screening in pregnancy is vital, since stillbirth and congenital infection are threats to the baby. Assault disclosure is handled with sensitivity, and forensic care is offered where it is needed.

steps.tx: On examination the chancre has a clean firm painless base with discrete rubbery **shotty nodes**. Look for a scaly rash that includes palms and soles, and broad moist **condyloma lata** around the anus. Express the meatus for milky discharge, and palpate a fluctuant grooved swelling of chancroid. Swab the throat and rectum, and screen for tabes with pupils and reflexes. Use darkfield microscopy for motile treponemes, check pH with whiff and clue cells, and test first void urine by **nucleic acid amplification**.
steps.say: The sore is inspected for a clean painless base with firmness, and discrete rubbery nodes are felt. A scaly rash that covers palms and soles is sought, with broad moist warts around the anus. Discharge is milked gently from the urethra, and the groin is palpated for a fluctuant swelling. Throat and rectal swabs are taken for other sites, and nerves with pupils are screened for tabes. Darkfield microscopy can reveal motile organisms, and first void urine is tested for confirmation.

vis.alt: Multi-panel image showing a painless genital chancre, a scaly palmoplantar rash, perianal condyloma lata, and motile Treponema pallidum under darkfield microscopy.
vis.caption: Key clinical signs and bedside microscopy for syphilis and STIs. Image: Jerad M. Gardner, MD, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons.

steps.tx: Send **VDRL or RPR** as screening tests with titres, and confirm with **TPHA or FTA** treponemal tests. Remember the prozone effect, where high titres give a false negative unless the serum is diluted. Test first void and rectal samples by nucleic acid amplification for gonorrhoea and chlamydia, examine swelling fluid for chancroid organisms, and study spinal fluid when neurosyphilis threatens. Repeat triple screening in pregnancy and test for **HIV overlap**. Separate soft painful chancroid, grouped recurrent herpes, bubo forming lymphogranuloma, and oral plus genital ulcers of Behcet disease.
steps.say: VDRL or RPR screening is ordered with titres, and reactive sera are confirmed with TPHA or FTA tests. The prozone effect is remembered, where very high titres read falsely negative until diluted. First void and rectal samples are tested for gonorrhoea and chlamydia by amplification methods. Swelling fluid is examined for chancroid organisms, and spinal fluid is analysed when neurosyphilis threatens. Triple screening is repeated in every pregnancy, and HIV is tested for alongside. Soft painful chancroid is distinguished from grouped recurrent herpes, lymphogranuloma with bubo, and Behcet disease with mouth and genital ulcers.

steps.tx: The photograph shows a **VDRL dilution card** with reactive titres beside a microplate of confirmatory **TPHA wells**. Screening titres rise and fall with disease activity, so dilution to endpoint matters, and the prozone effect explains a negative result at high titre. Treponemal tests stay reactive after treatment and confirm true infection. Read the card as the laboratory does, match the titre to the clinical stage, and remember that **pregnancy screening** repeats each trimester.
steps.say: The photograph is a dilution card with reactive titres beside a confirmatory TPHA plate. Screening titres are tracked with disease activity, so each sample is diluted to its endpoint. A falsely negative result can occur at very high titre through the prozone effect. Treponemal tests remain reactive after cure, and they are confirmation of true infection. Every titre is matched to the clinical stage, and screening is repeated in each trimester of pregnancy.

vis.caption: Syphilis screening dilutions with confirmatory TPHA. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Treat early syphilis with single dose **benzathine penicillin**, repeating the course in late disease, and use doxycycline for chlamydia or as a syphilis alternative. Add ceftriaxone for gonorrhoea cover and aciclovir for herpes, given episodically or as suppression. Treat partners at the same time through expedited therapy, and warn about **Jarisch Herxheimer fever** with rigors at the start. Desensitise penicillin allergy in pregnancy to shield the baby, promote condoms with vaccines and screens, and follow titres with partners and the baby until **cure is confirmed**.
steps.say: Early syphilis is treated with single dose benzathine penicillin, and the course is repeated in late disease. Doxycycline is prescribed for chlamydia or as a syphilis alternative, with ceftriaxone added for gonorrhoea. Aciclovir is used for herpes control, and sexual partners are treated at the same time. Fever with rigors can follow the first injection, so every patient is warned in advance. Penicillin allergy in pregnancy is desensitised to shield the baby, and condoms are promoted with regular screens. Titres with partners and the newborn are tracked until cure is confirmed.
